title: Tandoori Chicken Salad
description: Oven-baked tandoori chicken breast marinated in spiced yogurt, chopped and folded into a tangy Greek yogurt and mango chutney dressing with crunchy celery, carrot, and red onion. Great in wraps, pitas, or over greens.
ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
½ cup (120 g) plain 0% Greek yogurt (marinade)
1 tbsp lemon juice, about ½ lemon (marinade)
⅓ cup (80 g) plain 0% Greek yogurt (dressing)
1 tbsp lemon juice, about ½ lemon (dressing)
¼ small red onion (30 g), minced
instructions: Pat 1.5 lb (680 g) chicken breasts dry. Score each breast on both sides with 3–4 shallow diagonal cuts about ¼ inch deep.

In a bowl or zip-top bag, mix ½ cup (120 g) 0% Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp lemon juice (about ½ lemon), 2 grated garlic cloves, 2 tsp grated ginger, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp ground turmeric, ¼–½ tsp cayenne, and 1 tsp kosher salt until smooth.
Add the 1.5 lb (680 g) scored chicken breasts and coat them thoroughly, working the marinade into the cuts. Cover and refrigerate for 8–12 hours. Do not exceed 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper third. Line a sheet pan with foil, set a wire rack on top, and lightly spray the rack with canola oil.

Scrape most of the excess marinade off the 1.5 lb (680 g) chicken breasts, leaving a thin coating, and arrange them on the rack without touching. Bake for 20–25 minutes, until the thickest part reaches 165°F.
Switch the oven to broil and broil the chicken for 2–3 minutes, watching closely, until the edges are charred in spots.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then let it cool for another 10 minutes. Chop it into ½-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk ⅓ cup (80 g) 0% Greek yogurt, 1½ tbsp (30 g) mango chutney (chop any large mango pieces), 1 tbsp lemon juice (about ½ lemon), ¼ tsp kosher salt, and ½ tsp garam masala.

Add the chopped chicken (from 1.5 lb / 680 g raw), 2 diced celery stalks (80 g), 1 diced medium carrot (60 g), ¼ minced small red onion (30 g), and 2 tbsp chopped cilantro if using. Fold until evenly coated.
Taste, and adjust with up to ¼ tsp more kosher salt or 1 tsp more lemon juice if needed. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving so the flavours meld.
notes: Each serving is about 210 g; weigh the finished batch and divide by 4 for accuracy. Macros count all of the marinade, so actual numbers run slightly lower once the excess is scraped off. To use store-bought tandoori rub instead of the spice blend, replace the paprika, cumin, coriander, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, and cayenne with 2½–3 tbsp rub, and only add the 1 tsp salt if the rub is salt-free. For extra flavour at no macro cost, smoke the chicken at 400°F until it reaches 165°F instead of baking. Keeps refrigerated for 3–4 days.
